evidence.model_evidence: All 60 live retrieval records were examined. Every record is an off‑topic search result: Wikipedia pages, QA training sites, French consumer forums, gaming forums, adult‑content sites, Bundesliga football pages, ILIAS learning‑platform URLs, musician biographies, Bing quiz pages, and Google Chrome download pages. None exposes a real job‑board listing/API or a direct QA/test vacancy card for Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden, or Germany‑wide remote.
